ops.title: stack rebase: a pre-rewrite parent copy origin once published is not unpublished work
ops.body: PR #382 (2026-10-12): stackCarriedUnpublished now excludes every head in refs/remotes/<remote>/<pin>'s reflog, so a child carrying a parent copy origin published and a rewrite superseded replays onto the published head instead of refusing 'carries N commit(s) of <pin> that origin does not'. Patch-id matching would not have covered the monorepo incident (07c8c81 vs 005dc66 differ by a renumbered migration); reflog membership does. Side finding, unfixed: when every live branch has no open PR, stackPlan replans with noPush (stackBare), which skips stackPinOtherLanes, so a held parent whose remote was rewritten refuses with 'mid has diverged from origin/mid' instead of being kept. Tests must stub open PRs (stubStackPRs) to reach the pushing path.
